Why Esports Orgs Manufacture Rather Than Print

Esports apparel has a specific problem: sponsors change mid-season, rosters change faster, and a printed patch or heat-pressed logo looks exactly like what it is on a 4K broadcast. Most orgs start with printed blanks and outgrow them the moment a real sponsor arrives.

Sublimation solves it properly - sponsor panels and org marks are dyed into the fabric, so they cannot crack, peel or shift, and a new sponsor simply means new artwork on the next run. At twenty pieces an amateur or collegiate team can order the same construction a pro org uses, and the merch side can run on the same approval with your own labels. Questions

What is the minimum order for custom esports jerseys?

20 pieces per design - enough for a roster, coaching staff and a few spares. Hoodies and merch start at 50 pieces, with a 20-piece trial option.

Can each jersey carry a different player handle?

Yes - individual handles and roles are part of the production run at no per-piece setup penalty. Send a name and size list with your artwork.

How do you handle sponsor logos?

Sponsor panels are sublimated into the fabric rather than heat-pressed, so they survive washing and read cleanly on camera. A sponsor change means new artwork on the next run rather than a patch over the old one.

How much does a custom esports jersey cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Comparable sublimated jersey baselines on our published pricing page run $18 per garment at these quantities, falling with volume; zip-ups and hoodies are itemised separately.

How long does an esports order take?

Design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks, express DDP delivery 3-7 days - plan around your season or event date.
